name: NuExtract3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-23. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.539 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-29. IMAGE EVALS 2026-10-23: the card publishes a second panel as images. md2st.svg gives "Content Extraction (OCR)" average score 70.1 for NuExtract3 at the legend value "non-thinking score" (338 thinking tokens printed on the badge). This is NOT the same measurement as the NuMind structured-extraction row: that one is structured-extraction precision over ~600 documents, this one is document-to-Markdown content extraction, so both are kept. st.svg (structured extraction, 65.2 thinking score) restates the existing row and was not added a second time; ocr_preferences.svg prints win rates of other OCR models against NuExtract3, which is a ranking not a score, so nothing was taken from it.

benchmarks.name: NuMind structured extraction (internal, ~600 documents)
benchmarks.config: Card table, same table both columns: NuExtract3.4_4B-RL 0.651 +/- 0.019 vs base Qwen3.5-4B 0.417 +/- 0.031. For context the same table puts gemma-4-E4B-it at 0.538, Qwen3.5-9B 0.479, GLM-4.6V-Flash 0.435. NOTE the scored row carries a '.4' version tag while the repo is plain NuExtract3; the card frontmatter says model_name NuExtract3 and presents this as its headline result, so it is read as this repo's row. vLLM, temperature 0.25, 65000 max output tokens (thinking + answer).

benchmarks.name: Content Extraction (OCR) average score
benchmarks.config: Figure md2st.svg on the card: the NuExtract3 (4B) bar reads 70.1 under the legend entry "non-thinking score"; the badge above the bar is 338 thinking tokens. Non-thinking (direct answer) is therefore the setting read. No shot count or harness printed. Read off the card figure BY EYE (the card publishes this panel only as a picture). Read-by-eye caveat: +/-0.5 at this resolution.
